lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A regular grid of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters organized into approximately 10 vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, with inter-spot distance increasing toward the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary circular blobs, forming a distinct rectilinear lattice across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible, defined by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side, spanning the length of the visible flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains approximately 15 small, discrete high-luminance blobs, with a higher spatial frequency observed toward the posterior margin and the base of the fin.

other_distinctive_markers: The cranial region anterior to the gills displays a high-density vermiculated pattern of small spots and labyrinthine lines, contrasting with the geometric grid on the flank.
